scope.condition: The high-severity path is limited to the Vite development server on Windows alternate paths. Takos production ships static documentation output and never runs or publishes the VitePress development server.
scope.removeWhen: Remove this waiver as soon as a stable VitePress release accepts a fixed Vite/esbuild graph, or a scoped override passes docs build and development/HMR checks on the repository's supported Bun toolchain. VitePress 2 prereleases are not a GA dependency.
scope.reassessment: Stable VitePress remains 1.6.4 with Vite ^5.4.14. The vitepress>vite override resolves Vite 6.4.4 and esbuild 0.25.12 on Bun 1.4.2, but the CI-pinned Bun 1.3.14 ignores it and rejects its version-3 lockfile. A global Vite override would also replace the Web UI's Vite 8.1.5. Retain the four exact dev-only advisories without widening scope; evidence and follow-up are recorded in security/TASK-0020-vitepress-waiver-review.md.
